verdict.rationale: First-party docs show you can upload your own models from Hugging Face, local files, S3 or Azure Blob, and do it programmatically through a REST API. LoRA adapters can be served by live merge or by multi-LoRA with dynamic loading at request time, deployed with a single firectl command on dedicated on-demand GPUs, at base-model prices. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom weight and LoRA uploads and serving work as documented.
